serviceRules.title: Service rules
serviceRules.intro: Please read our service rules carefully before you continue.
buyItems: USDT purchases are available only to persons strictly over 18.
Buying USDT on behalf of third parties is prohibited.
Have a passport with you when purchasing.
Verification is required for your first purchase.
sellItems: USDT sales are available only to persons strictly over 18.
Selling USDT on behalf of third parties is prohibited.
Have a passport with you when selling.
Verification is required for your first sale.
generalItems: Minimum amount for exchange is 10,000 ₽; payments below this will not be processed.
We accept USDT on the TRC-20 network only.
Be careful: we are not responsible for USDT sent outside the TRON blockchain network.
When USDT is credited to our balance, it will be automatically exchanged at the current rate.
USDT crediting on the TRON network usually takes 3 to 10 minutes.
serviceRules.footer: By continuing to use our service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and fully agree to these rules.

aboutPage.hero: Welcome to our cryptocurrency exchange bot!
aboutItems: We have been exchanging cryptocurrencies for over 3 years.
We work for cash rubles only.
You can buy USDT with no commission at the best rates in Moscow.
A $3 fee applies when withdrawing USDT on the Tron network.
officeItems: Moscow, Presnenskaya Embankment 12, Federation-East tower, 77th floor, office 04
We are here for you from 12:00 to 00:00. No weekends.
To get an office pass and buy USDT, create a request through the bot.
